notes.title: Bug Fixes, CPU Optimization & In-Game Chat
notes.notes:
We want to express our heartfelt gratitude to everyone who has purchased and supported our game. Seeing so many players enjoying the experience we've created is incredibly exciting. Your enthusiasm drives us to keep improving and expanding the game.

We're excited to bring you our latest update, which includes several improvements and fixes:

New Feature

 In-game chat: Press Enter to open the chat window and communicate with other players while hiding in a bush.

Performance Improvements

 CPU optimization: Animations are now less CPU-intensive when other players are out of sight.
 Reduced foliage: Bushes and small trees have been reduced by 20% to help find players in the forests.

Balance Changes

 Human speed adjustment: Humans are now as fast as robots when uninjured, and 5% slower than robots when injured.

Bug Fixes

 Fixed a climbing exploit in Cemetery tunnels.
 Resolved an issue where matches would start without any hunters.
 Fixed missing level boundaries in the Snow Village map.

Coming Soon

We're thrilled to announce that we're working on a new map! Stay tuned for more information about this exciting addition to the game, which will be released soon.

notes.title: RELEASE DATE: OCT. 21 2024
notes.notes:
Greetings,

Over 1,000 testers logged in and tried the game during our playtest week, and we're thrilled with how players received it and the fun they had. We've been working nonstop, and we're excited to announce that we're ready to launch on October 21st—just 10 days away! So get ready, load up your shotgun and movement sensors, and join us for the hunt. Now, let's dive into the playtest results.

Playtest Feedback

We're delighted that most players enjoyed the simple yet engaging hide-and-seek gameplay. We also received numerous ideas to add more variety in actions and game modes. We'll introduce some of these as customizable settings for sessions, while others will be implemented as separate modes after launch. The playtest also helped us uncover many bugs that our internal testing missed, making it a resounding success. We've already fixed all the issues found during the playtest.

We've added several quality-of-life features you requested, including lobby-ready indicators, player muting options, in-game server setting adjustments, voting for the next map, and more interesting ways to score and become the best hider in your lobby.

We've also improved the process of finding games when there are no active lobbies or games currently running.

Content on Release

Our original concept was simple, and we wanted to maintain that essence. We've mainly focused on adding more survivor and hunter characters for you to play as, along with more maps. The game will launch with four maps, each offering substantial replayability and unique settings. We're confident you'll enjoy many sessions with your friends, and we're excited to hear about your favorites when the game launches!

We will be introducing more characters and maps in future updates, alongside new modes and hunters. Our commitment to expanding the game doesn't end at launch – we have exciting plans to keep the content fresh and engaging for our players.

Map Showcase: Cemetery

Those of you who participated in the playtest have already experienced this map, but we wanted to share pictures with everyone to showcase what we've been working on. This map has a very different layout compared to the warehouse, featuring paths that lead to graveyards and a large church visible from all areas of the map. The church serves as a monument for orientation. Behind the church, there's a pathway to an underground crypt that could be either your best hiding spot or your final resting place.
